_note: Thresholds are SCREENING approximations drawn from citable sources (see each entry's `source`). An entry with an empty source is hidden by the app (Req 5.2). `verified` stays false until a human teammate checks the cited source against the value; while false the app shows an 'unverified' badge (Req 5.3). These were populated by an agent, not a human verifier, so both remain verified=false by design.

species.name: American lobster
species.source: Upper thermal stress threshold (juvenile/adult), ~20 C bottom water. Tanaka & Chen (2017), 'Implications of Future Northwest Atlantic Bottom Temperatures on the American Lobster Fishery', J. Geophys. Res. Oceans, DOI 10.1002/2017JC012949. Corroborated by CT DEEP / NOAA (20 C / 68 F upper thermal stress threshold) and behavioral avoidance studies (Watson et al. 1999; juveniles avoid >20 C, Lawton/ Golet).

species.name: Winter flounder
species.source: Screening sublethal/avoidance threshold (juvenile/adult), ~22 C bottom water for this cold-water flatfish (occupied range ~0-25 C, scarce at the warm end). Pereira et al. (1999), 'Essential Fish Habitat Source Document: Winter Flounder (Pseudopleuronectes americanus), Life History and Habitat Characteristics', NOAA Tech. Memo. NMFS-NE-138. https://repository.library.noaa.gov/view/noaa/3135
